name: four-act-console
description: Four-Act Console — a browser dApp that polls a live EvaporChain node's /api/four_act + /api/network/health and renders the chain's death ledger: eulogies, tombstones, refresh pool, mortis state, evaporation MMR, conservation-audit streak. Open dapps/four-act-console/index.html in a browser; defaults to the permanent public node at http://89.167.52.40:8099.
